test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following years, the Nawab of Awadh accepted the subsidiary alliance initiated by Lord Wellesley, the Governor General of British India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1801**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 1801, the Nawab of Awadh, Saadat Ali Khan II,** entered into the **Subsidiary Alliance** with the British.
 
• This alliance was devised as a political and military strategy by** Lord Wellesley, **the **Governor-General of British India, in 1798**.
 
• The terms of the Subsidiary Alliance included several stipulations:
 
 
• The Nawab was required to cede nearly half of his kingdom to the British, encompassing territories such as Rohilkhand and the region between the Ganga and the Jamuna rivers.
 
• The Nawab had to disband his own troops and rely instead on a British-managed army.
 
• The Nawab was obligated to pay substantial subsidies, often amounting to several lakhs of rupees.
 
• Article IV of the treaty affirmed that the forces provided by the British East India Company were deemed adequate to safeguard the ruler of Awadh.
 
• These terms effectively diminished the autonomy of the Nawab and established British dominance in Awadh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Richard Colley Wellesley,** 1st Marquess Wellesley, was an Anglo-Irish politician and colonial administrator.
 
• He initially held the title of Viscount Wellesley until 1781 when he inherited his father's title as the 2nd Earl of Mornington.
 
• Later, in 1799, he was bestowed with the Irish peerage title of Marquess Wellesley. Additionally, he held the title of Lord Wellesley in the Peerage of Great Britain.
